anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
Running /skill:using-git-worktrees for acme/widget#82. The caller passed resolved PR values, so `reference/pr-head.md` replaces Steps 0 and 1.

## Aliases

| Alias | Value |
|---|---|
| ROOT | /work/widget |
| W | /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry |
| A | aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa (headRefOid) |
| B | bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb (origin/main) |
| C | cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc |
| D | dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd |

## Shared discovery (cwd = session cwd, which is ROOT unless a row says otherwise)

| # | Command or check | Result |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir` | /work/widget/.git, so ROOT is set |
| D2 | `git rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` | empty, so this is not a submodule |
| D3 | Overrides ladder: `.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`, ROOT/`gauntlet-overrides.md`, ROOT/`doc/gauntlet-overrides.md` | absent, no native tool, no wrapper. Name is `fix-retry`, so home is W |
| D4 | `git -C ROOT fetch origin` | succeeds |
| D5 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse --verify -q A^{commit}` and `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/fix/retry` | both give A |
| D6 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/main` | B, so BASE_SHA=B |
| D7 | Stop 1: isCrossRepository | false |
| D8 | Stop 2: `git -C ROOT worktree list --porcelain` | fix/retry is not listed |
| D9 | Stop 4 precondition: `git -C ROOT rev-parse --verify -q refs/heads/fix/retry` | exits 1, so no local branch and stop 4 is skipped |

D4 through D9 all happen **before any write** (the pre-write boundary).

## Shared success path

| # | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| S1 | `git -C ROOT status --porcelain` | empty, exit 0, so the source is clean |
| S2 | `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry` | Git's unique-remote DWIM gives `--track -b fix/retry W origin/fix/retry`. This is not a caller-supplied `-b`. |
| S3 | `git -C ROOT worktree list --porcelain` | prints `worktree W` |
| S4 | `git -C W rev-parse HEAD` | A, so PRE_REWORK_HEAD=A and BASE_SHA=B |
| S5 | `git -C W merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main` | already up to date; recorded as `merge: no-op - head contains origin/main` |
| S6 | `git -C W merge-base --is-ancestor A HEAD` | exits 0 |

The process cwd never changes.

**Report R:**
```
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa (clean)
PR: acme/widget#82
Pre-rework head: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
Base SHA: bbbbbbb
merge: no-op - head contains origin/main
Ready to implement rework for acme/widget#82
```

No provenance note is added, because the caller supplied the head as the base. Thread fetch is out of scope here.

## Provisioning rows

| Row | Delta from shared path | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| linked | D1 runs with cwd /work/widget/.worktrees/other and still gives /work/widget/.git, so ROOT=/work/widget. `other` is not the selected home, so it is not adopted and no tree is nested inside it. S1 through S6 run against ROOT and W. | Report R |
| primary | D1 runs with cwd ROOT. Everything else is shared. | Report R |
| ancestor | D9 finds C. `git -C ROOT merge-base --is-ancestor fix/retry origin/fix/retry` exits 0. After S1, `git -C ROOT update-ref refs/heads/fix/retry origin/fix/retry`, then `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry` on the existing branch, with no DWIM and no `-b`. No `branch -f`. S3 through S6 follow. | Report R |
| reuse | D8 lists W on fix/retry. That is the selected home, so stop 2 does not fire. D9 finds C and the ancestry check exits 0. Dirty-tree ask: `git -C W status --porcelain` is clean. `git -C W merge --ff-only origin/fix/retry`, then S4 gives A. No `worktree add`, then S5 and S6. | Report R |
| fork | Stops at D7: `PR #82's head lives on fork contributor/widget; rework needs an in-repo branch.` | Stop. Only fetch and reads ran (D4 to D6); D8 and later did not. |
| elsewhere | Stops at D8: `branch fix/retry is checked out at /work/widget/.worktrees/pr-82; finish or remove that worktree first.` | Stop before S1. No writes. |
| unreachable | D5's verify fails: `PR #82 head aaaaaaa is not reachable (origin/fix/retry is at ddddddd); the branch moved.` | Stop after fetch, before D6 and any write |
| moved | D5's verify passes, but origin/fix/retry is D. Same text: `PR #82 head aaaaaaa is not reachable (origin/fix/retry is at ddddddd); the branch moved.` | Stop after fetch, before D6 and any write |
| ahead and diverged (two runs, each identical) | D9 finds C, and `git -C ROOT merge-base --is-ancestor fix/retry origin/fix/retry` exits 1: `local branch fix/retry is at ccccccc, not an ancestor of origin/fix/retry (aaaaaaa); rework needs the PR head.` | Stop. No update-ref and no add. |
| override | D3 finds an overrides file whose `## using-git-worktrees` has `create: helper create -b <branch> <name>`. Home stays default, so W. The template contains `-b`, so it is skipped and S2 runs the built-in DWIM checkout. | Report R, plus the line `create: override skipped (contains -b)` |
| race | After S2 and S3, S4 gives D, not A: `worktree /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry HEAD dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd differs from PR #82 head aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa; the branch raced after checkout.` | Stop. W is left intact, with no remove, reset, or clean. PRE_REWORK_HEAD is not captured, nothing is merged, and no report is produced. |

## History

The branch advances only by merge, and every commit reachable from A is preserved. No `rebase` is allowed. `reset` and `commit --amend` may not replace any commit at or below A. Keeping the tree current means `git -C W merge origin/main`, never a rebase.

Two existing flow steps are allowed and unchanged:
* **Appended-spec approval:** `commit --amend --no-edit` on the spec commit, which sits above A.
* **Appended-wave fold:** `reset --soft "$WAVE_BASE_SHA"`, provided WAVE_BASE_SHA descends from A.
